_meta.name: OODA MAS Thesis Policy Database
_meta.purpose: This Policy Database defines the behavioral constraints and optimization objective of the Multi-Agent System. It ensures that the Strategist maximizes the total optimization function F = U - λ·P while respecting efficiency, pacing, volatility response, and risk boundaries.

optimization_objective.description: The system must maximize F = U - λ·P.

volume_score.explanation: Each lead is worth CHF 500. During holiday periods, each lead receives an additional CHF 100 bonus.

cpa_penalty.explanation: Deviation from target CPA reduces utility. Larger inefficiencies are penalized proportionally.

leakage_penalty.logic: If conversion rate drops below baseline and CPA exceeds target, spending is considered toxic and penalized proportionally to spend and performance gap.

budget_penalty.explanation: Budget deviation is penalized increasingly throughout the day. Early hours prioritize performance; late hours prioritize full budget utilization.

policy_logic: If CPA slightly above target → reduce bids gradually.
If CPA significantly above target → reduce bids aggressively.
If CPA remains above hard threshold for multiple hours → escalate.

budget_pacing_policy.objective: Spend the full daily budget without large hourly deviations.
policy_logic: Early in the day → prioritize CPA efficiency.
Late in the day → prioritize spending remaining budget.
Avoid large underspending unless CPA protection requires it.
If CVR drops moderately → reduce bids.
If CVR drops severely → pause campaign to prevent leakage.
If CVR surges significantly → increase bids cautiously.

conditions_for_escalation: CPA above 120 for more than 3 hours.
Campaign paused for more than 6 hours.
escalation_policy.purpose: Prevent autonomous drift and maintain trust.

policy_logic: Do not react to single-hour anomalies.
Require persistence before large bid or pause decisions.

execution_constraints.description: Operator must validate that all actions stay within safe operational bounds.
